sections.content: When responding to food requests, confirm what is available using 'Van' (there is) and describe the food.

items.spanish: Van kenyér, vaj, sajt, tej és víz.
items.english: There is bread, butter, cheese, milk and water.

items.spanish: Van két darab alma, de kevés a sajt.
items.english: There are two pieces of apple, but (there is) little cheese.

sections.content: When listing items that exist, use 'Van' once at the beginning, then join the items with 'és' (and). No article is needed before each noun.
